title: Mishang Urban Texture 广告牌
description: This is just an ordinary billboard resource pack, requiring Mishang Urban Construction and Fabric API as dependencies.
body:
# Introduction：


- This resource pack is a billboard texture pack for the [Mishang Urban Construction mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/mishang-urban-construction)You can freely replace it with your desired images.
- Note: Do not rename the folder.
- You may use the[MTR (Minecraft Transit Railway) ](https://modrinth.com/mod/minecraft-transit-railway)mod to build stations and decorate them with billboards.

# Dependencies：


- Required mods: [Mishang Urban Construction](https://modrinth.com/mod/mishang-urban-construction) （and[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)as a mandatory dependency）


# Usage Guide：
- For instructions on importing images or creating custom billboards, check the linked[Bilibili tutorial video.](https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV14hRYBkEqE/spm_id_from=0.0.favlist.content.click&vd_source=26ec9b54c17c9693c48c1902125876e3)

# Author & Feedback：
- Author’s [Bilibili profile](https://space.bilibili.com/1333851778)
- If you encounter any issues, join the [QQ channel](https://qm.qq.com/q/3VZvfbtKt2)or send a private message for feedback.

# Supported Versions：
- As of May 10, 2026, only compatible with Minecraft 1.20.1 (Fabric)
